description: This file defines a custom exception class QueueCacheMissException used within the Orleans.Streams namespace to handle cases where a requested cache item is missing in the queue cache. It extends DataNotAvailableException and provides additional properties for tracking sequence tokens related to the cache miss.

classes.name: QueueCacheMissException
classes.description: A sealed exception class indicating a cache miss in the queue cache, with properties for requested, low, and high sequence tokens.
